Rune Master
0 Mana, plus 10 per sec
2 sec cast3 min cooldown
Empowers your spellcasting while draining mana periodically for 15 sec.

Each time you deal Magic Damage you gain 3% increased spell haste, 3% increased Magic Damage, and 3% increased mana costs.

While active you can not move, but Ley Walk and Warp are able to be cast to reposition.
